editionLabel: Classic Zombicide — original Season 1 English rules
firstPlayerRule: Decide together who starts, then give that player the first-player token. The rulebook explicitly says not to choose randomly because Zombicide is cooperative. The token holder takes the first turn.
clarifications: After everyone has taken a turn, the first-player token passes to the player on the left for the next game turn.
